name: Session History
description: Contributes the SessionHistory tool: paginated, filterable read access to any saved session's transcript (this one or a past one) from the append-only JSONL store. Window records, list or search sessions, filter tool calls by name, read spilled tool-output blobs, or produce the full markdown or XML dump. The tool reads only through the ctx.host capability surface (sessions:read, blobs:read). Distinct from SessionInfo, which reports the current run's live state.

tool.name: SessionHistory
tool.description:
Read a saved session from the transcript store. It can be this session or a previous session. For the live context, quota and cost, use `SessionInfo`.

`window` (the default) gives records in pages. `search` finds text in one session or in the newest sessions. `blob` gives the full output of one tool use, before the cut. `dump` gives the full session and is large: use `window` when possible.

action.description: The data to read. The default is `window`.

sid.description: The session: a full id, the start of one id (for example, `260d72dd`), or `last`. The default is `last`, the newest session in this `cwd`, or the newest of all. A start that agrees with more ids gives an error with these ids. `list` does not use it. For `search`, no `sid` examines the newest sessions.

anchor.description: For `window`: `start` (the first record) or `end` (the newest record). The default is `end`.

offset.description: For `window`, `list`, `search` and `tool_calls`: the items to ignore, from the `anchor` for `window`. The default is 0.

limit.description: The page length. For `window`, the default is 10 and the maximum is 500. For `list`, the default is 25. For `search` and `tool_calls`, it is 20.

previewChars.description: For `window` and `search`: the maximum characters of each record body. The default is 600 for `window` and 160 for `search`.

query.description: For `search`: the text to find. For `list`: text in the `sid` or `cwd`. It is case-insensitive.

cwd.description: For `list`: only the sessions with this `cwd`.

tool.description: For `tool_calls`: only the uses of this tool, for example `Bash`. The default is all tools.

toolUseId.description: For `blob`: the `tool_use` id of the output.

maxBytes.description: For `blob`: the maximum bytes. The default is 65536.

format.description: For `dump`: the output format. The default is `markdown`.

tool.reason: perfect collision: plugin IS the tool name
